basic_details.job_title: GSSSB Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 131 Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Online only, via OJAS portal (OTR registration mandatory)

important_dates.online application start: 28 September 2026 (2:00 PM per Para 20; Para 1 mentions 6:00 PM)

age_limit.details: Note: Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may get relaxation in the upper age limit as per the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or other relaxation.

qualification.details: The candidate must be a citizen of India, or possess nationality as provided under Rule-7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. | Important: Candidates lacking a valid computer-knowledge certificate may still apply, but must submit proof of passing a basic computer knowledge test before appointment; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of selection. Candidates without Gujarat Nursing Council registration must obtain it before appointment.
qualification.education_qualification: B.Sc. (Nursing) from a recognized University/institution (UGC-recognized/deemed under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956), recognized by the Gujarat Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council

salary_details.details: Regularization after 5 years remains subject to the outcome of SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012 pending before the Supreme Court, as stated in the official notification.

selection_process: Paper I (Nursing) 2 hours Fundamentals of Nursing 20
Selection is through a single-stage competitive written examination (MCQ)
conducted in two papers as per the Health & Family Welfare Department's exam rules:

Each paper has 100 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each. Paper I may be answered in Gujarati or English; Paper II is in Gujarati only. Negative marking: ¼ mark deducted for each wrong answer. Qualifying standard: Minimum 40% separately in Paper I and in Paper II
for all categories. The merit list is prepared on the combined marks of both papers
for candidates who clear both qualifying standards. Document verification is called for approximately twice the number of vacancies per category
based on provisional merit. A provisional answer key is published after the exam
followed by a final answer key after considering objections; cancelled questions are handled on a pro-rata basis. Widow candidates and eligible sports candidates (national/international
inter-university or All India School Federation level) receive an additional 5% of marks scored
subject to certificate verification. Final selection list and waiting list are prepared on merit
how_to_apply: Complete OTR (One Time Registration) on ojas.gujarat.gov.in if not already registered — only OTR-registered candidates can apply.
Go to "Online Application" → click Apply → select GSSSB.
Select Advertisement No. 458/2026-27, Staff Nurse, Class-3 and click Apply.
Read the "More Details" notification carefully before proceeding.
Click "Apply Now", enter your Registration No. and date of birth, and click "Apply with OTR" to open the application format; fill in Personal Details.
Fill in Educational Details in the next step.
Accept the declaration/assurance ("Yes") and click Save to generate the Application Number.
Upload photograph (5 cm × 3.6 cm, white background, dated, taken within one year before the last date) and signature (2.5 cm × 7.5 cm), in JPG format under 15 KB each.
Click "Confirm Application" after a final review — no edits are possible after confirmation; a Confirmation Number is generated.
Print and keep the confirmed application; download it before the last date as it cannot be downloaded afterwards.
Pay the requisite exam fee online by 15 October 2026, 11:59 PM and save the receipt.

content_sections.text: Note: Educational qualification, age limit, and category-certificate validity are all reckoned as of the last date of application, 12 October 2026. Candidates must have completed OTR registration on OJAS before filling the application.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026 (Category-wise)
content_sections.text: 46 Unreserved (General) 85 Reserved Category Total 131 Total Posts Note: The notification states the number of posts may increase or decrease. Reserved-category vacancies are applicable only to candidates who are original residents of Gujarat and belong to the respective reserved category. If no eligible woman candidate is available for a women's reserved post, it will be filled by a male candidate of the same category. Posts not reserved for women are open to both male and female candidates on merit.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India, or possess nationality as provided under Rule-7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Important: Candidates lacking a valid computer-knowledge certificate may still apply, but must submit proof of passing a basic computer knowledge test before appointment; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of selection. Candidates without Gujarat Nursing Council registration must obtain it before appointment.

rows.details: B.Sc. (Nursing) from a recognized University/institution (UGC-recognized/deemed under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956), recognized by the Gujarat Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council
Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery (GNM) from an institution recognized by the Gujarat Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council
Basic computer application knowledge as prescribed under Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967
Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, or both
Must be registered with the Gujarat Nursing Council under the Gujarat Nurses, Midwives and Health Visitors Act, 1968 at the time of appointment (if not already registered)

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Age Limit
content_sections.text: Note: Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may get relaxation in the upper age limit as per the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or other relaxation.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Pay Scale 2026
content_sections.text: Regularization after 5 years remains subject to the outcome of SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012 pending before the Supreme Court, as stated in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a single-stage competitive written examination (MCQ), conducted in two papers as per the Health & Family Welfare Department's exam rules: Each paper has 100 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each. Paper I may be answered in Gujarati or English; Paper II is in Gujarati only. Negative marking: ¼ mark deducted for each wrong answer. Qualifying standard: Minimum 40% separately in Paper I and in Paper II, for all categories. The merit list is prepared on the combined marks of both papers, for candidates who clear both qualifying standards. Document verification is called for approximately twice the number of vacancies per category, based on provisional merit. A provisional answer key is published after the exam, followed by a final answer key after considering objections; cancelled questions are handled on a pro-rata basis. Widow candidates and eligible sports candidates (national/international, inter-university or All India School Federation level) receive an additional 5% of marks scored, subject to certificate verification. Final selection list and waiting list are prepared on merit, category-wise vacancies, and document verification outcome.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSSSB Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Only the last confirmed application (with fee paid) will be considered valid if a candidate submits more than one application. Fees paid against earlier applications are not refunded.

content_sections.heading: Examination Fee
content_sections.text: Fee is payable online only (debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet) plus applicable transaction charges. No refund is given to candidates who appear in the exam or whose applications are rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for GSSSB Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The GSSSB has announced a total of 131 vacancies for the Staff Nurse position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSSSB Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the GSSSB Staff Nurse recruitment is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates is between 18 and 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Nursing) or a Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery from a recognized institution, along with basic computer knowledge and proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age relaxation for women?
faq.answer: Yes, women candidates are eligible for age relaxation of up to 5 years beyond the standard maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q7. How will the selection be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a written test consisting of two papers (Nursing and Gujarati), followed by document verification and the preparation of a final merit list.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years, after which they will be placed in the Level-5 pay scale of Rs. 29,200 - 92,300.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply?
faq.answer: While the recruitment is for Gujarat, candidates must possess knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi as per the eligibility criteria to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official GSSSB website at https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in before the specified deadline.
